SectionObject.Title: Buildings
SectionObject.Text1:
The image sequence shows how the AI model gradually learns to identify buildings and becomes more and more confident in identifying them. It is also possible to see that the AI model is not perfect and in many places errors occur. The fact that these errors occur can, for example, be due to the small the amount of training data that has been in the red training area.

The red areas show the two training areas used to train the AI model. These areas are from a very limited part of the city but can still tell us something about the overall picture of the composition of the whole city.

The training method for the AI model is called supervised learning, i.e. we humans control and help the AI model to understand.

SectionObject.Title: Vegetation
SectionObject.Text1:
The image sequence shows how the AI model gradually learns to identify vegetation and becomes more and more confident in identifying it. It is also possible to see that the AI model is not perfect and in many places errors occur. The fact that these errors occur can, for example, be due to the small the amount of training data that has been in the red training area.

Is there access to the desired amount of green space in Norrköping? Having access to green space is both a matter of increased experience and quality of life, but also important from a climate adaptation perspective. The green surface helps both to infiltrate water in the event of rain and to reduce high temperatures in the summer. The AI model can measure the amount of green space over an entire city in a way that could not be done before.

SectionObject.Title: Asphalt
SectionObject.Text1:
The image sequence shows how the AI model gradually learns to identify asphalt and becomes more and more confident in identifying it. It is also possible to see that the AI model is not perfect and in many places errors occur. The fact that these errors occur can, for example, be due to the small the amount of training data that has been in the red training area.

Knowing where there are asphalt surfaces is interesting both to be able to calculate e.g. snow shoveling but also to gain an understanding of hot surfaces can occur. Asphalt absorbs and stores heat for a long time, something that can give rise to a warmer city.
